I changed the default in `src/config.ts` from `5000` to `10000`. But `npm start` will still use **5000 ms (5 seconds)**.

The start script is `node --env-file=.env src/server.ts`, and `.env` sets `SHOP_TIMEOUT_MS=5000`. That value overrides the code default, so the new 10-second default only applies when `SHOP_TIMEOUT_MS` is unset. I ran `npm start` and it printed `timeout=5000`.

If you want `npm start` to use 10 seconds, change `.env` to `SHOP_TIMEOUT_MS=10000` or delete that line. I left `.env` alone because it looks like a deliberate local override. Do you want me to update it?
